youtube.title: 🔥 Clone Any Website With One AI Command
youtube.description: Lost your website's source code? Migrating from WordPress to React? This repo solves both problems in one command. AI Website Cloner Template uses AI coding agents to reverse-engineer any live site into clean Next.js code. Just point it at a URL, run /clone-website, and your agent extracts design tokens, downloads assets, writes component specs, and rebuilds everything in TypeScript. Over 20,000 developers use this for platform migrations, recovering lost codebases, and learning how production sites work. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and 10+ other agents. MIT licensed, modern stack with Next.js 16, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS v4. Check the repo link in bio.

linkedin.text:
Ever lose a website's source code?

Your client's developer disappears. The WordPress site is live but you can't touch the code. Or you need to migrate to modern React but rebuilding from scratch would take weeks.

I just found a repo that fixes this: AI Website Cloner Template.

One command. Any URL. Your AI agent does the rest.

It screenshots the site, extracts every design token, downloads all assets, and reconstructs the entire thing in Next.js and TypeScript. Not a screenshot-to-code toy — real component specs with exact CSS values, responsive breakpoints, and interaction states.

Over 20,000 developers are using it for platform migrations and code recovery.

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and 13 other AI coding agents. MIT licensed. Ready to use today.

Next time you face a lost codebase or legacy migration, you'll have a solution.

Repo link: https://github.com/JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template
